mutation_experiment.setup_correction: Initial write_text fixture used Windows CRLF and was correctly rejected for mismatching LF preimages; corrected fixture uses write_bytes.

development_observations: Ordinary preexisting Cargo.lock normalization must remain supported. Final owner permits unstaged lockfile refreshes but rejects modification of explicitly staged lockfiles; the retained staged lockfile regression exercises that distinction.
limitations: Python complete-context API only; no real OMP integration claim.
Trusted local Cargo/build scripts/proc macros, not a hermetic sandbox. Freshness hashing detects lasting changes, not transient write-and-restore or mutations after return.
Only surviving written .rs files receive individual reachability controls. Context-only operations run the combined Cargo selection without claiming per-file compilation.
Generated/external diagnostic source identity remains ambiguous; unchanged lockfiles may be refreshed by Cargo.
The selected Clippy rule is not a global code-correctness or safety claim.
Windows directory case sensitivity must match the disposable copy. Unavailable FileCaseSensitiveInfo queries or mismatches fail visibly; case-sensitive-directory emulation is not implemented.

independent_review_correction.finding: Distinct lib/test diagnostic variants at one physical occurrence were falsely budgeted as multiple final occurrences.
independent_review_correction.repair: Bind each consumed baseline primary to its candidate raw primary; share only at that same final occurrence.

prior_smoke_and_mutation_provenance: The throwaway_smoke and mutation_experiment sections describe the preceding 60859cc3 snapshot proof; revised real-Cargo regression and exact reviewer-fixture checks above validate the correction.

native_alias_correction.native_reachability_provenance: Director relayed native owner compiled-addon oracle: two creates src/fresh.rs then src/FRESH.rs, both preimages absent; actual filesystem retains one entry and last writer bytes. Author did not run native addon.
native_alias_correction.repair: Canonicalize materialized filesystem paths for final replay bookkeeping, never universal casefold; retain last writer original-source identity.

populated_case_sensitive_original.error: CandidateError: original/copied directory case sensitivity differs

empty_case_sensitive_original.error: CandidateError: original/copied directory case sensitivity differs

native_alias_correction.observed_support: Default case-insensitive Windows source/copy contexts support native aliases; mismatched original/copy FileCaseSensitiveInfo rejects before Cargo. No directory flag emulation or broad new portability claim.

semantic_freshness_correction.finding: Setup-only source/copy flag equality falsely permitted an original output-directory flag change during Cargo while file bytes stayed identical.
semantic_freshness_correction.repair: Retain and requery original directory observations consumed by copying/replay, including absence of every proposed-parent segment and the existing ancestor flags. Bind WinAPI functions once.
semantic_freshness_correction.fixture_cleanup: Both retained real-build-script cases reset the private output-directory flag before temporary workspace removal. No reviewer path was executed or modified.
